description: This source file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection related to configuring and adding AdoNetGrainDirectory services in an Orleans-based hosting environment. It includes a static class with a method to facilitate registration and configuration of AdoNetGrainDirectory with dependency injection.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure AdoNetGrainDirectory services.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: An extension method for IServiceCollection that registers and configures an AdoNetGrainDirectory, setting up options, validation, logging, and grain directory creation.
